messages:
Alex P: thinking out loud — we keep running into follow-up friction after incidents. proposal: a tiny 'retro-lifecycle' signal bot that does three things automatically when an incident is marked RESOLVED: 1) creates a private retro channel named #retro-INCID-<id>, 2) posts a filled-in postmortem template with impact/owner/action slots, and 3) kicks off an ActionBoard card + webhook so owners appear on the remediation dashboard. any immediate 👍/👎 or missing pieces?

Maria G: love this. two quick asks: a) dedupe — some incidents are follow-ups of older ones, we should detect parent/child and link instead of new retro channel, b) schedule — owners are busy; can the bot create an optional poll for a 30/60 min sync slot next week?

Sam K: +1. for dedupe we can check the incident metadata (parent_incident_id) and also check affected-service tags. If parent exists, post a comment into the parent's retro channel and append a follow-up section rather than spin up a new channel.

Jess: we should make the template explicit about customer impact and comms timeline (who told whom and when). also want a field for 'rollback decision rationale' when relevant. API-wise I'd prefer the bot expose a slash command to re-open the template if someone wants to add more context: `/retro-edit INCID-12345`

ops-bot: automated note — current runbook suggests manual retro creation in #postmortems; transition checklist: 1) incident -> RESOLVED 2) owner tags 3) manual retro creation. proposed bot would replace step 3 and keep audit trail. :robot_face:

rotation-bot: small handoff edge case: if incident resolves during shift change, who is owner? need the bot to respect oncall_needs_handoff = true and set owner to last acknowledged pager or put owner as `oncall-team` until human assigns.

Ryan: legal/security flag — some incidents involve customer PII. bot must be able to mark retro channel as restricted and not auto-create links to external dashboards unless owner confirms. Also audit log for who viewed what.

Alex P: good catches. implementation sketch: -> when RESOLVED event fires, bot runs workload: detect parent, determine visibility (public/restricted), create channel if needed, post template, create ActionBoard card via webhook, and optionally ping owners with poll. add a "do not auto-open" tag for security-sensitive incidents.

Sam K: sample payload for ActionBoard webhook (rough):
```json
{
  "inc_id": "INCID-1715009999",
  "summary": "Database failover caused 502s",
  "severity": "sev2",
  "owners": ["@Alex P", "@Sam K"],
  "retro_url": "https://slack.com/archives/C01234567",
  "visibility": "restricted"
}
```

Maria G: template fields I'd like: impact_summary, customer_count_estimate, RCA_owner, remediation_deadline, verification_steps, comms_timeline, linked_incidents, compliance_flags, notes_for_support. keep fields short — aim for a 10–15 min read.

Jess: dashboard wiring: ActionBoard should accept tags so the Cost/Latency/Compliance owners can filter. also want an automatic regression check that ties the incident to recent deploys (git sha) and flags if same sha involved in >1 incident in last 30d.

Alex P: operational plan and owners: - prototype bot (sam) - draft template and sample retro content (maria) - actionboard webhook + payload schema (jess + sam) - policy for restricted incidents (ryan + legal) - handoff rules (rotation-bot tweaks by infra team)

Sam K: i'll spin up a PoC repo today. naming for slash commands: `/retro-start`, `/retro-edit`, `/retro-close`. thinking the bot responds with ephemeral confirmation and posts a link to the created channel.

Maria G: i'll put a first-pass template in Google Drive and share a link in the channel.

Ryan: i'll list the compliance flags and do a quick doc on retention/access for restricted retros.

Jess: callout: we should allow manual override in case support needs to redact a thread before it goes into ActionBoard. add `--hold` flag to `/retro-start` that requires explicit release.

Alex P: sounds good. let's aim for PoC end of week and demo at next oncall sync. quick poll: who can review the PoC on Friday 10:00 PT? Maria G: +1, Sam K: +1, Jess: maybe, Ryan: can't, Alex P: +1. i'll schedule and drop calendar invite. thanks all. :party_parrot:
